claims.source: Implicit in eqs (2.5)/(2.8) with Table-1 MCF7 parameters
claims.claim: (Paper does not state this directly.) Post-repair fixed point should be stable so <Y>, <Z> decay to 0.
claims.status: CONTRADICTED for MCF7 (det = -145, unstable); BORDERLINE for MDA-MB-468 (ratio 0.987, det = +197).
claims.implication: MCF7 fitted parameters produce an ODE that diverges past ~1-2 h. Either (a) the SSA cap Zmax=1000 implicitly stabilises in the published Figure 4b without being in eq (2.5), or (b) the paper's Figure 4b time horizon is short enough to hide this. Bare eq (2.5) integrated to 24h gives MCF7 <Y>=3622 (vs Ymax=300), <Z>=11313 (vs Zmax=1000).
